user.title: Bird Buddy account
user.description: Sign in with your Bird Buddy account. Accounts created through Google or Facebook sign-in are not supported; invite a separate email account as a member instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bird Buddy API.
error.no_feeders: No feeders found on this account.

init.title: Livestream options
init.description: The feeder streams on battery power, so the livestream is stopped automatically. Set a go2rtc address (for example http://192.168.1.10:1984) to route the stream through it, which is more stable and works in every browser.

data.start_timeout: Wait for the stream at most

data_description.start_timeout: A sleeping feeder on a weak signal may need well over a minute.
data_description.go2rtc_url: Leave empty to let Home Assistant read the HLS stream directly.
data_description.go2rtc_input: Name of an ffmpeg template defined in go2rtc.yaml. Leave empty unless you know you need it.
data_description.transcode: The feeder sends HEVC, which only plays in Safari without transcoding.
